Eginhard, King Karl, Roland, Ogier and captured Moors. King Karl, surrounded by Roland, Ogier, knights, ladies and Pagen, approaches in solemn procession and climbs a throne built on the left, while loud homages are offered to him by the invading people. Eginhard bows to him, the King and the knights greet Eginhard. Trabants carry the conquered trophies ahead
Previous, Emma with virgins. As soon as Fierrabras sees Emma, he reveals the most extreme surprise
Eginhard, Ogier and Knight with the white flag, palm tree and the other peace signs. As they stand on the slope of the height, they return once again to the side from which they came.

Eginhard, Brutamonte and Mauren Eginhard, facing the knights on the left, is standing, sunk down in a murky afterthought. Brutamonte sneaks up from the height and from the gorge in the background to the right with a scourge of Moors. When they see Eginhard, they stop first, observing him - then they point to the knights wandering in the distance, look at them for a longer time, and when they think they are far enough away, they descend from the hill and approach Eginhard, who does not notice them. Eginhard wants to seize the front of them. Eginhard escapes them with a clever lateral movement and draws the sword against them. Fighting, Eginhard wins the rock ledge in the foreground right, to which he rushes up. He strikes the following Moors back and hits the horn.
